Container.Name: dptv-recorder
Container.Overview: DPTV Recorder - a self-hosted channel guide and DVR for Xtream Codes (XC) IPTV servers. 7-day EPG timeline, click-to-play live preview, and scheduled recording straight to raw .ts files via ffmpeg.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI is served on

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (channels/EPG/settings) is stored. This is the ONLY place that path is configured - do not add a DB_PATH variable.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where recorded .ts files are written. Point this at a disk with real room - raw .ts is not small. This is the ONLY place that path is configured - do not add a RECORDINGS_PATH variable.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as, so files it writes are owned correctly. Unraid default (nobody): 99

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default (users): 100

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your local IANA timezone, e.g. Australia/Perth. Needed to correctly interpret EPG times from providers whose xmltv.php omits a UTC offset.

Config.Name: GPU (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pass through an Intel iGPU for future hardware-accelerated transcoding. NOT required for recording or .mkv remuxing (both are pure stream copy, no GPU use at all) - leave blank unless you specifically need this. If set, typically /dev/dri.
